CROSSBOW HUNTER
CR 6

XP 2,400
Human gunslinger (bolt ace) 6
CN Medium humanoid (human)
Init +6; Senses low-light vision; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 16, flat-footed 15 (+4 Dex, +2 dodge, +5 armor)
hp 49 (6d10+6+6)
Fort +7, Ref +10, Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee masterwork quarterstaff +7/+2 (1d6 B)
Ranged +1 seeking light crossbow +13/+8 (1d8+5, 19–20/×3, range incr. 80 ft., AP 1 CW)
Special Attacks crossbow training (light crossbow)

STATISTICS

Str 10 (+0), Dex 19 (+4), Con 12 (+1), Int 10 (+0), Wis 16 (+3), Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +6; CMB +6; CMD 21
Feats Deadly Aim, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Reload (light crossbow), Rapid Shot, Weapon Focus (light crossbow)
Skills Acrobatics +12, Bluff +8, Knowledge (local) +9, Perception +12, Stealth +9
Languages Common
SQ deeds (gunslinger initiative, pistol-whip, sharp shoot, shooter’s resolve, vigilant loading), grit (max. 3 points)
Gear 2 potions of cure light wounds, potion of invisibility; Other Gear +1 chain shirt, +1 seeking light crossbow with 30 bolts, masterwork quarterstaff, boots of the cat, cloak of resistance +1, eyes of the owl, 50 gp
